_about: Ethylene carbonate (1) + Water (2): total pressures against temperature, 312.91-383.13 K, at set liquid compositions. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of ethylene carbonate, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record.

source.citation: Y. Chernyak, Phase Equilibria in Binary Mixtures of Water with Cyclic Alkylene Carbonates, J. Chem. Eng. Data 53 (2008) 603-606
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 9. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. No isotherm of the set has its own pure-component pressures, so the fit uses the vapour pressures of the component records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
